raw_segments.text: Miss Deuce's brave eyes, unregarded, turned from the cross-blind, smitten by sunlight.
Smitten, the smiting light, she lowered the drop-blind with a sliding cord.
She drew down Pensive, why did he go so quick when I?
About her bronze, over the bar where bald stood by sister gold, in exquisite contrast,
contrast in exquisite non-exquisite, slow, cool, dim, sea-green sliding depth of shadow,
